summary: This bill establishes a biometrology laboratory program within the National Institute of Standards and Technology to conduct measurement research for engineering biology, biomanufacturing, and biotechnology, and to develop related technical standards, guidelines, and best practices.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes specific appropriations for the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) to establish and carry out a biometrology laboratory program. This directly involves increasing government spending for scientific research and development.

The bill establishes a program at NIST to develop standards and research for engineering biology, biomanufacturing, and biometrology. This includes supporting the development of tools, technical standards, and guidelines for biological data, which inherently touches upon data protection and oversight within the context of biological technologies.
